observed_failure.symptom: The next synchronous OpenVINO GPU inference did not return; progress and CSV writes stopped.
observed_failure.recovery: SIGTERM sent to the exact verified PID; process exited.

interpretation.scope: This is evidence of a host GPU.0/OpenVINO native inference hang under the current long-run configuration; it is not a numerical correctness failure and does not establish the exact plugin, driver, kernel, scheduling or hardware cause.

next_action: Do not repeat the unguarded 30-minute run. Add an external per-inference watchdog and run a bounded reproduction/diagnostic before any new acceptance attempt.
